name: synapse
description: See every coding agent on your machine as a live node, link them, and let them share context and message each other

scripts.demo: rm -rf /tmp/synapse-demo && SYNAPSE_DEMO=1 SYNAPSE_HOME=/tmp/synapse-demo PORT=${PORT:-4848} node server.mjs
scripts.app:build: CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config app/build/electron-builder.json && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/mac-arm64/Synapse.app && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --prepackaged dist/mac-arm64/Synapse.app --config app/build/electron-builder.json
scripts.app:install: npm run app:build && rm -rf /Applications/Synapse.app && cp -R dist/mac-arm64/Synapse.app /Applications/ && open /Applications/Synapse.app
